basis.basis_identity_rule: All five v50 direction arrays receive content hashes; the reconstructed straight-basis ledger, fifth-direction audit, anchors, and every scalar identity available in v47 must match v47. v47 did not publish direction-array hashes, so no retrospective hash-equality claim is allowed.

truth_constraints.field_limit: minimum of 1.01 times Direct-K4 field relative-L2 and Zero field relative-L2
truth_constraints.gradient_limit: minimum of 1.01 times Direct-K4 gradient relative-L2 and Zero gradient relative-L2
truth_constraints.normalized_margin_formula: For q in {field,gradient}, margin_q(w)=1-relative_squared_q(w)/(limit_q^2); a scored point is feasible only when all values are finite and min(margin_field,margin_gradient)>=-5e-8.

feasible_parameterization.map: For latent (d,r), find the largest retained lower endpoint t in [0,1] for which t*d has finite normalized margins and both margins are >=0, using 60 frozen bisection steps, then return w=r*t*d.
feasible_parameterization.convexity_reason: The box and both squared-norm truth constraints are convex and contain the origin, so the segment from zero to the retained radial endpoint is feasible.
feasible_parameterization.zero_direction_behavior: If L_inf(d)<=1e-15, return w=0 and t=1 without bisection.
feasible_parameterization.nonfinite_bisection_behavior: Any nonfinite latent coordinate or normalized margin is a fatal execution error and produces no objective score.
feasible_parameterization.endpoint_recheck: After bisection and after multiplying by r, recompute all margins; an endpoint outside the box or below -5e-8 is a fatal execution error and produces no exact forward.

deterministic_global_search.objective: exact curved-observation squared relative-L2 at the feasible mapped weight

deterministic_local_stencil.starts: the four global-search records with smallest exact objective after absolute-L_inf deduplication of their mapped weights
deterministic_local_stencil.normalized_coordinates: direction coordinates use u=(d+2)/5 and radial fraction uses u=r
deterministic_local_stencil.boundary_rule: Apply each normalized offset and reflect once at 0 or 1; all frozen offsets are at most 0.5 so one reflection is sufficient.
request_order: for normalized dimensions 0 through 5, for signs -1 then +1, eight axial scales in listed order
for all 15 dimension pairs in lexicographic order, four sign pairs (-1,-1),(-1,+1),(+1,-1),(+1,+1) at pair scale
three coupled sign rows in listed order at coupled scale

frozen_anchors: v43 feasible four-direction point with zero fifth weight
v44 selected weights radially mapped to feasibility
v47 best diagnostic candidate radially mapped to feasibility

members_in_request_order: all four frozen anchor exact-score requests
all fixed local-stencil objective requests in start-index order
candidate_bank.deduplication: Scan the request ledger in order and retain the first row unless an earlier retained mapped weight has L_inf distance <=1e-10.
candidate_bank.local_start_order: Deduplicate global-search mapped weights with the same first-match rule, then sort by (objective, global_request_index, latent_lexicographic) and retain the first four.

all field, gradient, and observation metrics are no worse than Zero
observation is no worse than Direct-K3 plus 1e-12
candidate is not Pareto dominated by Direct-K3

stage_transition_and_decision_rule.stage_1_witness: at least one S2 candidate passes the complete frozen v40 gate after independent replay, with the global search and all four 160-request local stencils valid, fully accounted, and deterministically replayed
stage_transition_and_decision_rule.stage_1_fixed_roster_no_witness: no S2 candidate passes, the global search and all four 160-request local stencils are valid and complete, every objective request and candidate is accounted for, every exact-scored point and every derived metric or ratio is finite, nonnegative where applicable, and truth feasible, all frozen inputs, source files, and basis arrays match, and independent replay agrees; this is a finite-roster negative only and does not close the five-direction route
stage_transition_and_decision_rule.stage_1_inconclusive: input or basis parity, deterministic global replay, canonical-center identity, fixed-stencil roster identity, request accounting, candidate completeness, finite/feasible checks, budget, or independent replay fails
stage_transition_and_decision_rule.five_coefficient_learning_target_authori: all four snapshots independently contain at least one complete-gate witness under the same frozen search
stage_transition_and_decision_rule.stage_2_exact_reuse: For each of S1, S3, and S4 separately, repeat the same feasible map, PCG64 seed, 1664-request DE cap, four fixed 160-request local stencils, four anchors, request-order candidate roster, complete gate, input release checks, and independent replay. No snapshot may borrow candidates, starts, or budget from another snapshot.
